## ⬇ Which file do I download?

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** 10 / 11 | `ScriVoiceSetup-….exe` |
| **Mac** with Apple chip (M1, M2, M3, M4…) | `ScriVoice-…-mac-AppleSilicon.dmg` |

Download **one file** from **Assets** below. Ignore **"Source code"**: it is for programmers.

### Windows
1. Open the `.exe`. If you see **"Windows protected your PC"** → **More info** → **Run anyway**.
2. Click **Next** until the end, then open **ScriVoice** from the Start menu.

### Mac
1. Open the `.dmg` and drag **ScriVoice** into **Applications**.
2. First launch: **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.
3. Allow **Microphone**, **Accessibility** and **Input Monitoring**, then restart ScriVoice.
4. Intel Macs are not supported.

### Use
Click where you want to write, press **Ctrl + Alt + Space** (Windows) or **Ctrl + Shift + Space** (Mac), speak, press it again.

📖 [Full guide (PDF)](https://github.com/philipjpj/scrivoice/blob/main/docs/ScriVoice-Guide-EN.pdf)
